REQ: LANG-421 LANG-422 LANG-423 LANG-424 LANG-425 program greeter implicit none integer, parameter :: dp = kind(1.0d0) real(dp) :: area integer :: i, times character(len=*), parameter :: name = "world" logical :: ok times = 2 ok = .true. .and. .not. .false. area = 3.14159_dp * 1.5_dp**2 ! Loop over the greetings. do i = 1, times if (i == 1 .or. ok) then print *, 'Hello, ', trim(name), '! it''s ', i else if (i .gt. 1) then write (*, '(A, F8.3)') "area = ", area end if end do call show(times) contains subroutine show(n) integer, intent(in) :: n print *, "n = ", n, size([1, 2, 3]) end subroutine show end program greeter
